title: Human-Centric Spatio-Temporal Video Grounding With Visual Transformers
venue: IEEE Transactions on Circuits and Systems for Video Technology

problems.name: Spatio-Temporal and Object/Event-Level Grounding
problems.evidence_sentence: In this work, we introduce a new task named Human-centric Spatio-Temporal Video Grounding (HC-STVG), which aims to localize a spatio-temporal tube of the target person in an untrimmed video given a query description.

problems.name: Cross-Modal Semantic Alignment Gap
problems.evidence_sentence: We tackle this task by proposing an effective baseline method named Spatio-Temporal Grounding with Visual Transformers (STGVT), which utilizes Visual Transformers to extract cross-modal representations for video-sentence matching and temporal localization.

problems.name: Dataset, Benchmark, and Evaluation Mismatch
problems.evidence_sentence: Grounding in both space and time domain is often required in real-world scenarios, especially for healthcare and security related applications, where the surveillance videos can be extremely long, but people only care about a speciﬁc person and his/her speciﬁc behaviors.
